description: 📑 PageIndex: Document Index for Vectorless, Reasoning-based RAG
summary: PageIndex replaces the chunk-and-embed pipeline with a hierarchical tree index built from document layout, then lets an LLM reason its way through that tree to surface relevant pages, which is closer to how I actually navigate a 200-page regulatory PDF or a dense bioinformatics methods paper. The engineering is neat: tree extraction is layout-based and cheap, only the retrieval step needs a strong model, and the whole thing runs locally with `pip install pageindex` and your own key, no vector DB to babysit. For Proreerfolio's job-fit checks the traceability angle matters — when a candidate asks why a match was flagged, I can point to the exact pages the model traversed rather than an opaque cosine-similarity score, and that kind of auditability is the difference between a tool people trust and one they don't.
